title: Claude Code is unable to respond to this request
body:
API Error: Claude Code is unable to respond to this request, which appears to violate our
     Usage Policy (https://www.anthropic.com/legal/aup). Please double press esc to edit your
     last message or start a new session for Claude Code to assist with a different task.

For context, it was a html prasing code. I'm starting to feel the service degrade the past 5 days.
author: JohnDotOwl

top_comments.body:
Just type in some base64:

`SGVsbG8gd29ybGQ=`

This is "Hello world" encoded in base64 format

Please fix your oversensitive filtering, base64 is very common in development and having AUP violations just from having it anywhere in a chat is very stupid. I pay $200/month for this, the quality of your filtering is unacceptable.
